title: Effectiveness of Move to Let Social Enterprises Run Hawker Centres
what_it_is: Effectiveness of Move to Let Social Enterprises Run Hawker Centres

sections.label: Socially-conscious hawker centre operators
sections.summary: Four hawker centres are managed by socially-conscious operators, which are expected to improve dining experience, vibrancy and operational efficiency.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: With their experience in food and beverage operations as well as property and lease management, we believe these operators are able to improve the dining experience, enhance the vibrancy and improve the operational efficiency of hawker centres under their management.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: There are currently four hawker centres managed by socially-conscious operators, namely, at Block 208B New Upper Changi Road and Bukit Panjang Hawker Centre which are managed by National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) Foodfare Pte Ltd, Hougang Ci Yuan Hawker Centre managed by Fei Siong Social Enterprise Ltd and Our Tampines Hub Hawker Centre managed by OTMH.

sections.label: Affordable dishes at Ci Yuan and OTH
sections.summary: Stalls at Ci Yuan and Our Tampines Hub must have at least two dishes priced at $2.80 or below.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: For example, the stalls at the centres in Ci Yuan and Our Tampines Hub (OTH) need to have at least two dishes priced at $2.80 each or below.

sections.label: Hawker training and management extension
sections.summary: New hawkers receive on-the-job training, 16 have benefited, and the alternative management model is extended with NFC appointed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The new hawkers are given on-the-job training to gain skills and knowledge that can help them in operating hawker stalls.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Thus far, 16 hawkers have benefited from this programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Given the encouraging outcomes observed in these pilots, we have recently announced an extension of the alternative management model to other hawker centres, with the appointment of NTUC Foodfare Co-operative Limited, or NFC, to manage a group of new and existing hawker centres.

sections.label: Entrepreneurship programmes for new hawkers
sections.summary: Ci Yuan has an entrepreneurship programme benefiting 16 new hawkers, and OTH has a train-and-place programme with three months training.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have noted earlier, in Ci Yuan Hawker Centre, they have an entrepreneurship programme where some 16 new hawkers have benefited.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In OTH, they also have a train-and-place entrepreneurship programme where new hawkers train with veteran hawkers for about three months and then they operate the stalls at OTH.

sections.label: Components of Bukit Panjang conservancy fees
sections.summary: The $1,600-odd conservancy fee at Bukit Panjang Hawker Centre comprises service and conservancy fees, table cleaning fees, and centralised dishwashing fees.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to the conservancy fees that the Member referred to, in effect, at Bukit Panjang Hawker Centre, this is not just one component, this $1,600-odd.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: It comprises three components: firstly, it is service and conservancy fees for general cleaning, routine maintenance and utilities of the common area; there is a second component which is table cleaning fees; and the third component is centralised dishwashing fees.
